description: API keys are not on sale at the moment and buy_key creates no order, so there is no order to check. Check a key order created with buy_key. Takes the claim token, reports whether the payment has been seen and whether the key is ready to claim

claim_token.description: Claim token of the order, 32 hex characters. Example: 5f2c9a0e1b7d4c3a8e6f0b1d2c3e4f5a

name: key_order_status

outputSchema.description: state of a key order: pending, paid, issued
